title: Thai Curry Paste #2
preamble:
1 and a half onions

1 padron chilli - de-seeded

1 teaspoon dry tamarind - soaked in hot water

2 teaspoons amchoor powder

2 teaspoons (heaped) ginger paste
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry tamarind - soaked in hot water
method: Chop onions in a food processor
Heat the spices in a small pan until they start to pop, allow to cool and grind together
Add the spices and the remaining ingredients into the food processor
